workloads.name: file_group_having_order
workloads.sql: SELECT grp + 1 AS k, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY grp + 1 HAVING sum(score) > $1 ORDER BY sum(score) DESC, k

workloads.name: file_computed_sort
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score, label FROM items ORDER BY score::i64 * 3 + grp::i64 DESC, id

workloads.name: file_distinct_sort
workloads.sql: SELECT DISTINCT score % 997 AS s, grp % 31 AS g FROM items ORDER BY s, g

workloads.name: file_hash_join_residual
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*), sum(l.score::i64 + r.score::i64) FROM join_left l JOIN join_right r ON l.k = r.k AND r.score <> l.score
